note: Post-execution provenance supplement for E01 manifest.

runner_script.limitation: The runner script was an untracked working-tree file at the time of the E01 run. The manifest's source_file_sha256 covers only src/bayesbreak/**/*.py. The post-execution SHA256 recorded here reflects the file as it currently exists; it cannot be independently verified to match the exact run-time state. Complete script-level reproducibility cannot be claimed from the manifest alone.

bootstrap_definition: 2000 resamples of independently generated datasets (full sequences, not boundary positions within a single dataset). 95% percentile intervals.
calibration_note: Boundary-event probabilities are P(b_i=1|y) marginalized over k via the full posterior p(k|y), not conditional on a fixed segment count.
undersegmentation_note: At Delta/sigma=0.5, k=6: the geometric-decay prior (p(k) proportional to exp(-log(4)*(k-1))) places strong mass on small k. 95/100 replicates returned modal segment count 1 at n=256; 55/100 at n=512. This is prior-induced undersegmentation, not evidence of calibration or correct model behavior.
